title: HtmlAbbr
responsibility: Renders the native abbr element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlAbbr.attributes
inputs.description: Native abbr attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlAbbr.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native abbr element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlAbbr
outputs.description: The actual native abbr element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
